top3.headline: Microsoft now counts over 50 million agents under its governance layer
top3.whyItMatters: Agent control is becoming a platform purchase, so decide who governs yours before a vendor does.

top3.headline: Google Cloud revenue doubles as AI demand reaches the income statement
top3.whyItMatters: AI is now paying off in Google's revenue, so expect its AI investment push to continue.

top3.headline: On real tax work, the best agent passes one in ten
top3.whyItMatters: End-to-end professional work still needs expert review, whatever the model leaderboards say.

items.title: Microsoft says over 50M agents now run in Agent 365
items.takeaway: Microsoft Cloud passed $63B, up 30%; Foundry revenue more than tripled, per Nadella.
items.soWhat: Microsoft is selling agent governance outside the model, so ask how your agents are permissioned.

image.alt: Image from Satya Nadella on X

items.title: Vercel lets teams swap an agent's model without changing code
items.takeaway: Virtual Models give each agent task one model ID; model, fallbacks and data retention change centrally.
items.soWhat: With about 10 new models a week, central model switching keeps agents current without redeploys.

items.title: Kun Chen: CI is the next bottleneck once agents write the code
items.takeaway: Smarter test selection gave him 20x faster CI on a big codebase; trimming OS tests gave 15x.
items.soWhat: If agents ship faster than CI can check, your test pipeline sets the real delivery speed.

items.title: A third of large-company CISOs run autonomous agents with write access
items.takeaway: a16z surveyed 100 CISOs; 55% run MCPs or agent-to-app links in production.
items.soWhat: Agents with write access are already in production, so permissions and monitoring can't wait.

items.title: Alphabet hits a half-trillion run rate as Google Cloud doubles
items.takeaway: Revenue up 25%, Cloud up 103%; first-party model APIs near 32B tokens a minute, per Pichai.
items.soWhat: AI demand now shows up in Google's revenue, not just its spending plans.

image.alt: Image from Sundar Pichai on X

items.title: Vercel CI runs only affected tasks and lets agents drive it
items.takeaway: In beta on all plans; Vercel reports 2-6x faster push-to-pass internally.
items.soWhat: CI built for agents to trigger and read cuts the wait between an agent's change and a merge.

items.title: Particle launches inference for open models, claiming 45% fewer tokens
items.takeaway: Founder's claim, no benchmark named; Perplexity and Vercel AI Gateway are early partners.
items.soWhat: Token efficiency is becoming a selling point, so compare cost per finished task, not per token.

items.title: A tracking script hides jailbreak text to make AI refuse analysis
items.takeaway: Found in a 10,000-site crawl; under Node it also tries to read .env and other secrets files.
items.soWhat: Attackers now design code to stop AI reviewers, so keep humans and sandboxes in security review.

image.alt: nullpt.rs: A tracking script hides jailbreak text to make AI refuse analysis

items.title: Best AI agent passes 10.8% of expert tax assignments
items.takeaway: Surge's DAYJOB: Tax has 50 real-style client assignments across 1,789 files.
items.soWhat: Agents still fail most end-to-end professional deliverables, so keep experts signing off.

voices.quote: managed to keep parity in performance while using ~45% fewer tokens

hotOnX.text: Alphabet Q3: half-trillion annual revenue run rate, revenue up 25%, Google Cloud up 103%.
hotOnX.note: Hard numbers showing AI demand turning into revenue at Google's scale.

hotOnX.text: Particle launches: inference for open-weight models; particle-1 keeps parity using ~45% fewer tokens.
hotOnX.note: A new inference company promising cheaper open models, with Perplexity on board.

hotOnX.text: Vercel CI in beta: runs only the tasks a change affects, and agents can inspect and trigger it.
hotOnX.note: Builders want CI that keeps pace with agent-written code.

hotOnX.text: Microsoft Cloud passed $63B, up 30%; over 50M agents now in Agent 365.
hotOnX.note: Microsoft's CEO puts agent counts next to revenue as a headline metric.

hotOnX.text: Once teams stop reviewing most agent code, CI is the bottleneck: move checks to CD, modularize, select tests.
hotOnX.note: A concrete playbook for speeding CI, with 15x and 20x results.
